GT_nominal_electric: nominal 3 x 320 kW; ambient derating applies
GT_annual_min_ambient_electric: same recorded outdoor temperatures; all 3 available
GT_annual_max_ambient_electric: same recorded outdoor temperatures; all 3 available
DG_connected_electric: finite shaft work reserve; not available before startup/contact
electric_chillers: EC nominal capacity; power+common tower+CHW/fan path also needed
absorption_chiller: ABS nominal capacity; steam+electric auxiliaries+common tower+CHW/fan path needed
total_chillers_nameplate: sum of nameplate capacities only; coupled resources can reduce actual
boiler_building_heat_upper: boiler alone; before ABS steam competition
HRSG_building_heat_upper: 3 GT full fraction; before ABS steam and conversion competition

source: annual static demand/capacity ledger; no scenario simulation
